messages:
emily_cs: FYI Mosaic procurement paused their purchase order. Seeing a drop in power-user activity and their new ML lead wants a comparative eval before signing off.

system-bot: :warning: Usage anomaly for Mosaic — total generation tokens -42% WoW; 2 power users inactive for 28+ days.

raj_ae: Ugh. Do we know if this is purely a procurement timing issue or are they shopping competitors?

emily_cs: The new ML lead (Ava) requested a quick POC to validate inference cost, latency, and observability before procurement moves. Champion Jorge moved to Product a few weeks ago.

ava_mllead: Hi team — I joined Mosaic last week. Primary goal: confirm platform can meet 99th p95 latency at 512 tokens and show cost/perf tradeoffs. Also need end-to-end traces and KMS details for compliance.

taylor_se: I can run short microbenchmarks: hosted vs dedicated at 256/512 tokens, int8 quantized profile, and attach a 3-line repro script. Will include wall-clock p50/p95 and token cost. ETA EOD tomorrow.

zoe_onboarding: Onboarding status: config tasks 75% done. Pending: schema mapping for their product connector and a security checklist sign-off. I can prep the mapping templates and a sample connector config.

emily_cs: Suggestion: offer a 30-day dedicated POC with a small reserved pool, plus 4 SE hours for integration and telemetry wiring. Low-risk, timeboxed. Raj, is that ok from a commercial perspective?

raj_ae: Sounds reasonable. Offer terms: 30-day trial, usage capped at X tokens, SE hours included, and success criteria documented. I'll draft the POC terms and T&Cs.

security-eng: We can provide an ATO/KMS integration note and our compliance checklist. Need to know if they require HSM-backed keys or just cloud KMS.

ava_mllead: HSM not required for the POC but we will need cloud KMS with audit logs. Also would like to run the same microbench locally to reproduce latency.

emily_cs: Action plan: (1) SE microbench (taylor) — prepare hosted vs dedicated numbers + script, (2) Onboarding to finish schema mapping + sample connector (zoe), (3) CS to gather recent usage samples and sample prompts (emily), (4) Security to provide KMS/compliance note (security-eng), (5) AE to prepare POC terms (raj).

taylor_se: I'll include a small Dockerized repro that runs a 3-request loop at 512 tokens and emits traces to stdout. Also will show cost delta with and without quantization.

zoe_onboarding: I'll add a short walkthrough plan and ask for their priority personas (data scientists, infra, product) so the kickoff is tailored.

raj_ae: I emailed Ava a draft scope. Ava replied with availability: 2026-04-02 09:00 PT for kickoff.

emily_cs: Booked 2026-04-02 09:00 PT. Invite includes SE, Onboarding, AE, and Security. I'll circulate a one-pager with success metrics and the POC timetable.

security-eng: We'll post a 1-page KMS/compliance brief in the invite and join the kickoff for a 10-min Q&A.

ava_mllead: Appreciate the quick turnaround. If the POC reproduces your numbers and we can wire traces into our monitoring, Mosaic is likely to continue the contract.

emily_cs: Great. Goal: keep Mosaic engaged through a measurable, low-friction POC. Posting the kickoff agenda and owners here shortly.

system-bot: :white_check_mark: Actions recorded: SE=taylor_se, Onboarding=zoe_onboarding, CS=emily_cs, AE=raj_ae, Security=security-eng. Reminder set for 2026-04-02 09:00 PT.
